title: Police
key_finding: Winter Garden maintains a live Police Department page with Administration, Patrol Services, and Support Services, plus current contact information at 251 W Plant Street.

title: Administration
key_finding: WGPD says it protects an approximately 17 square mile area and currently employs 87 sworn police officers and 30 civilians.

title: Patrol Services
key_finding: WGPD describes active patrol functions including uniform patrol, bicycle patrol, a community liaison unit, and a canine unit.

title: Support Services
key_finding: WGPD describes active support functions including criminal investigations, property and evidence, school crossing guards, and traffic enforcement.

title: Staff Directory - Police
key_finding: The current staff directory lists Winter Garden Police with a non-emergency line, a 911 emergency line, Police Chief Steve Graham, and current patrol, administrative, support, records, and evidence contacts.

title: Citizens Police Academy
key_finding: WGPD advertises 2026 Citizens Police Academy sessions taught by Winter Garden police officers and staff in the department training room.

title: Records Requests - REV 01-16-2026
key_finding: The City's January 16, 2026 records-request memo gives a dedicated police-records request path through Winter Garden Police Department and Capt. Scott Allen as police records management liaison.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Winter Garden Police Department as a normal municipal row with population 48,469 and total index crime 963.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains a Winter Garden Police Department row with population 47,475 but publishes dashes instead of offense totals.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS offense workbook found no Winter Garden Police Department or FL0480500 row on the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 sheets.

title: FBI CDE agency roster by state abbreviation (FL)
key_finding: The official FBI CDE roster still lists FL0480500 as Winter Garden Police Department, agency type City, but marks is_nibrs as false with no nibrs_start_date.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: FL0480500 routes exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1278250 Winter Garden city.

title: jurisdiction_master.csv
key_finding: Winter Garden city is a municipal place target with agency_count 1 and is_contracted_place set to False.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: agency_master classifies FL0480500 as a local police department and flags source presence in both SRS and NIBRS years through 2024, even though the current FBI roster marks the agency non-NIBRS.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations carry substantive Winter Garden counts through 2020 but only zero-valued SRS annual rows in 2021-2024 and no NIBRS rows.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Winter Garden offense controls are fully fill-backed because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Winter Garden is queued as a high-impact full-fill municipal target with total_fill_count 1,130 and total_reported_count 0.
